Get started by creating a new block temp: Get started by creating a new block template.
block_templates_info: Block templates are HTML snippets that can be inserted into the page editor. The block identity (name) is preserved when inserted.
Cooperative members intro: Registry of Koperasi Pusat AB2TI membership. Each record belongs to one existing AB2TI Member.
Cooperative member selector help: Search an existing AB2TI Member. A person who already has Cooperative membership cannot be selected again.
Cooperative landing intro: Koperasi Pusat AB2TI is the association’s cooperative. AB2TI membership comes first, and Cooperative membership is optional.
Cooperative about one: Koperasi Pusat AB2TI is the cooperative of Asosiasi Bank Benih dan Teknologi Tani Indonesia. It is a member-owned economic body alongside the association, not a second identity for every AB2TI Member.
Cooperative about two: A person must already be an AB2TI Member before staff can establish Cooperative membership. Not every AB2TI Member belongs to the Cooperative.
Cooperative about three: The Cooperative currently supports member economic participation, including the PSN rice-milling activity described below. Savings and loan services are not currently offered as live products.
Cooperative PSN intro: PSN (Penggilingan Padi) is part of the Cooperative’s current business activity. Members who participate do so through the Cooperative, not as a separate public marketplace checkout.
Cooperative PSN share note: Participation units currently used in operations are described as Rp1,000,000 per share. Individual holdings and share ledgers are administered separately from this public page.
Cooperative PSN holdings deferred: Authoritative totals for PSN shares and participant counts will be published here once the Cooperative ledger is in place. This page does not invent those figures.
Latest Cooperative updates help: Published news and other publications marked as Cooperative updates.
No Cooperative updates yet: No Cooperative updates have been published yet.
Cooperative benefit current one: Optional Cooperative membership for eligible AB2TI Members, recorded by Cooperative officers.
Cooperative benefit current two: A public explanation of Koperasi Pusat AB2TI and its relationship to the association.
Cooperative benefit current three: A channel for Cooperative updates through the existing AB2TI publishing archive.
Cooperative benefit planned one: Member PSN participation statements and share accounting.
Cooperative benefit planned two: Savings and loan services, if they return as operating Cooperative products.
Cooperative membership is optional: Cooperative membership is optional for AB2TI Members. This badge is not a second membership card.
Cooperative workspace help: This status is read-only. Cooperative officers record membership. You cannot enrol or change it here.
Show as Cooperative update help: When published, this item can appear among latest updates on the Cooperative landing. It does not change the publication type or make drafts public.
Upload legacy spreadsheet help: Upload CSV or XLSX. Extra worksheets are listed after upload; select one source sheet. Parsing does not change Cooperative/PSN data until you commit.
Legacy import batches help: Each batch keeps staging rows. Canonical data changes only after commit.
Duplicate file warning: An identical file was uploaded before
Historical Cooperative funds help: Historical savings records are source-of-funds notes used in PSN participation. They are not a current savings balance and must not be added again to PSN participation value.
Preview does not change Cooperative\/PSN: Preview does not change Cooperative/PSN canonical data.
Historical funds are source of PSN parti: Historical fund records are the source of PSN participation, not a second current asset.
NIK is not a Member match key: NIK is classified evidence only. Matching uses identifier, email, phone, or manual verification — Member has no NIK field.
Commit confirmation help: Commit writes Ready rows into Cooperative/PSN records. Preview has not changed canonical data yet.
Reverse confirmation help: Reversal is blocked if later independent PSN adjustments exist. Original ledger rows are not deleted.
Select one worksheet. Hidden sheets are: Select one worksheet. Hidden sheets are not imported unless chosen explicitly.
PSN admin totals help: Totals count active Cooperative members with current PSN units greater than zero. Historical fund records are provenance and are not added to participation value.
Cooperative benefit current four: Recorded member PSN participation statements, and aggregate PSN share statistics on the public landing.
Anggota AB2TI yang akan dibuat dari data: AB2TI Members that will be created from historical Cooperative data
Import ini tidak membuat akun login\/Use: This import does not create login accounts or Users.
Data ini merupakan migrasi anggota AB2TI: This is a migration of people who are already historical AB2TI Members, not new membership registration.
AB2TI member count unavailable: Not published until the full AB2TI Member registry is marked complete.
Cooperative participation rate unavailab: Not published until the full AB2TI Member registry is marked complete.
PSN totals unavailable: Not published until legacy PSN share reconciliation is marked complete.
Delete previous legacy import data befor: Delete previous legacy import data before importing
Replace legacy import help: If checked, Cooperative/PSN data previously created through legacy import is cleaned first, then this file is imported as the new legacy source. Data that did not come from legacy import is not deleted.
Replace data mode warning: Data previously created through Cooperative legacy import will be replaced with data from this file. Operational data that did not come from legacy import is not deleted.
I understand previous legacy import data: I understand that previous legacy-import data will be replaced.
Legacy Members preserved: Legacy Members preserved because of independent dependencies
Cooperative dashboard intro: Operational workspace for Cooperative officers. Metrics below are resolved ledger figures, not incomplete organization totals.
Resolved ledger only: Resolved ledger only — not a final public total while reconciliation is incomplete.
Not final org total while PSN reconcilia: Not published as the final organization total while PSN legacy reconciliation is incomplete.
Name, email, phone, or record identifier: Name, email, phone, or record identifier
PSN adjustment edit help: Enter the desired total units. The system records a signed ledger adjustment. History is never overwritten.
Desired equals current: Desired units equal the current position. No change to record.
I confirm this PSN share change: I confirm this PSN share change and understand it will be written to the ledger.
Not available until PSN is reconciled: Not available until PSN is reconciled
Historical funds are not added to curren: Historical Simpanan Pokok and Simpanan Sukarela are source records. Do not add them to current PSN value.
Start the review again from the latest s: Start the review again from the latest share count.
This change will be recorded as new hist: This change will be recorded as new history and will not delete previous share history.
I understand PSN units will decrease: I understand that the share count will decrease.
Imported historical activity: Imported historical activity — not a manual staff action
Desired PSN units must be a whole number: Desired PSN units must be a whole number of 0 or more.
Expected current units must be a whole n: Expected current units must be a whole number of 0 or more.
Other reason requires an administrative: Other reason requires an administrative note.
Correction adjustments require an admini: Correction adjustments require an administrative note.
Share reductions require an administrati: Share reductions require an administrative note.
Confirm that PSN units will decrease.
Ordinary PSN share adjustment is unavail: Ordinary PSN share adjustment is unavailable while Cooperative membership is inactive.
PSN needs reconciliation before ordinary: PSN needs reconciliation before ordinary share adjustment.
The submitted PSN resources do not match: The submitted PSN resources do not match this Cooperative membership.
This confirmation request was already us: This confirmation request was already used.
The previous entry selected for correcti: The previous entry selected for correction does not belong to this PSN ledger.
The effective date cannot be in the futu: The effective date cannot be in the future for ordinary administrative PSN adjustments.
PSN shares changed since this page was o: PSN shares changed since this page was opened. Review the latest share count before confirming.

Knowledge intro: Practical agricultural knowledge for farmers, seed producers, AB2TI members, and practitioners.
No knowledge articles yet: No Agricultural Technology articles have been published yet.
No knowledge articles match search: No Agricultural Technology articles match that search.
Knowledge publishing help: Save as a draft at any time. Publishing and unpublishing are separate server-controlled actions.
Knowledge SEO help: Title and description are optional. If empty, the system uses the article title, summary, or body.
Latest knowledge articles help: The three most recently published knowledge articles.
Publish knowledge article confirmation: This article will appear on the public Agricultural Technology pages. Drafts cannot be opened by visitors.
Unpublish knowledge article confirmation: The article will return to draft and will not appear publicly. The last published date is kept.
Delete knowledge article confirmation: This draft will be deleted. A published article must be unpublished first.
From farmers, by farmers, for the nation. Building seed sovereignty and agricultural technology in Indonesia.
AB2TI public tagline: From farmers, by farmers, for the nation. Building seed sovereignty and agricultural technology in Indonesia.
Hero fallback primary: From farmers, by farmers, for the nation
Hero fallback secondary: AB2TI is a farmers’ association and agricultural knowledge platform. Visitors can read organizational publications, Agricultural Technology articles, and apply for association membership.
Welcome fallback content: Asosiasi Bank Benih dan Teknologi Tani Indonesia (AB2TI) is a farmers’ association committed to seed sovereignty and agricultural technology.
Welcome fallback secondary: AB2TI collects, characterizes, and conserves farmers’ seeds, and shares agricultural knowledge for more independent livelihoods.
What you can find at AB2TI: What you can find at AB2TI
Homepage orientation intro: This site offers organizational information, official publications, Agricultural Technology knowledge, Lapak Anggota, and association membership applications.
Pathway about help: Organization profile and information about AB2TI.
Pathway publications help: News, activities, and official publications that have been published.
Pathway lapak help: Find products and offers from AB2TI members. Contact sellers directly.
Pathway membership help: Learn about association membership, benefits, and the application process. Applying does not create a login account and is not cooperative membership.
Pathway cooperative help: Koperasi Pusat AB2TI is the association’s cooperative. Membership is optional for AB2TI Members.
Lapak intro: Lapak Anggota is where AB2TI members present products and offers. Visitors can contact sellers directly. Transactions do not take place on the AB2TI platform.
No lapak listings yet: No Lapak Anggota products are currently listed.
No lapak listings match search: No products match that search or category.
Seller transaction notice: Transactions take place directly with the seller.
No public seller contact: This seller has not published a public contact channel.
Storefront has no listings: This storefront currently has no available products.
Latest lapak listings help: A few currently listed products from AB2TI members. Contact the seller directly.
Membership landing intro: AB2TI membership is association membership. Visitors can apply without creating an account.
Membership is not cooperative membership: AB2TI membership is not the same as Koperasi Pusat membership, and this application does not enrol you in the cooperative.
Membership apply does not create an acco: Submitting an application does not create a login account. Staff will review your application.
Submitting is not membership approval: Submitting an application does not mean you have been approved as an AB2TI member.
Membership step fill: Fill in your details. You do not need an account.
Membership step send: Submit the application. You will receive a reference code.
Membership step review: AB2TI staff review the application. Approval is not automatic.
Staff will review after you submit: After you submit, AB2TI staff will review your application.
Fill the form to apply. Documents are op: Fill this form to apply for membership. Supporting documents are optional.
Required fields are marked: Fields marked * are required. The others may be left blank.
Please check the highlighted fields: Check the highlighted fields, then submit again.
Email is for contact, not an account: We use this email to contact you. It does not create a login.
Notes are optional: Optional. For example an organisation, region, or short note.
You may attach a photo, identity documen: You may attach a photo, identity document, or payment proof if you have them.
We received your membership application. Staff will review it.
Current application state awaiting revie: Current state: submitted and awaiting staff review.
Keep this reference code for support: Keep this reference code if you need support.
Reference code is not a login or status: This code is not a login, not an edit link, and not a status tracker.
What happens next after submit: What happens next, with currently supported behaviour: staff review the application. This page does not send automatic notifications.
If you just submitted, your reference co: If you just submitted, the reference code was shown after sending. This page does not show application status.
Revise application intro: Update the requested information, then resubmit. This is not membership approval and does not create an account.
Please update the requested information: Update the information according to the staff instruction.
Replace documents only if requested: Replace attachments only if requested. Previous files remain for history.
Revision submitted body: We received your updated application. Staff must start review again before a decision.
Internal notes are not sent to the appli: These notes are for staff only. Do not write applicant instructions here.
Rejection reason is optional and applica: Optional. Use wording that could be shown to the applicant. This is not an internal note.
Revision instruction is shown to the app: The applicant will see this text. Do not include internal staff notes.
Request membership application revision: The applicant will be able to correct data through a temporary link. The application is not approved or rejected yet.
Revision link operational note: Copy this link now and send it through the organisation’s current channel. The secret is not stored as text on the server. Automatic email or WhatsApp is not available.
Revision link copy failed: Could not copy. Copy the text from the box manually.
Revision already requested: Revision is already requested. Reissue the link if the previous one was lost or must be revoked.
Reissue revision link hint: Reissuing revokes the previous link. This instruction remains visible to the applicant.
Approve membership application confirmat: This will record exactly one AB2TI Member from this application. It cannot be undone in this version. A user account will not be created.
Reject membership application confirmati: This permanently rejects the application. An AB2TI Member will not be created. The applicant must submit a new application to apply again.
Member registry intro: AB2TI members after an application is approved. This is not the application queue, and not Kartu Anggota.
Record identifier is not Kartu Anggota n: This unique identifier belongs to the member record. It is not the approved Kartu Anggota AB2TI number.
Source application is not the member rec: The application is intake history. The member is association identity after approval.
Account link unlinked help: This member is not linked to a login account. Create an invitation and deliver the URL through a trusted channel. The secret URL is shown once.
Account link invited help: An invitation exists. The secret is not stored in plaintext. Reissue if you need to send it again.
Account link linked help: This member is linked to a login account. Do not create another invitation.
Account link expired help: The previous invitation is no longer valid. Create a new one if the member still needs to link an account.
Account-link operational note: Copy now and send through a trusted channel. The system does not email this URL and does not store the secret in plaintext.
Account-link copy failed: Could not copy. Copy it manually.
Site access inactive help: This member does not yet have a website account linked to AB2TI membership.
Site access invited help: An activation invitation is available. The secret URL is not stored in plaintext. Reissue if you need to send it again.
Site access linked help: A website account is linked to this membership. Do not issue another invitation.
Site access expired help: The previous invitation is no longer valid. Create a new one if the member still needs site access.
Site account email hint: Suggested from member contact data. Change it if the login email is different. This does not change the member contact email.
Activation link operational note: Copy now and send through a trusted channel. The system does not send this URL automatically and does not store the secret in plaintext.
Activation link copy failed: Could not copy. Copy it manually from the text box.
Member site access invitation intro: You received access to use AB2TI member services. An account is not linked automatically even if the email or phone number matches.
Connect account intro: This invitation connects your login account to the AB2TI member record. Matching email or phone is not enough.
Staff cannot connect membership: Staff accounts cannot be linked to membership. Sign in with the member’s personal account.
Account already linked elsewhere: This account is already linked to another AB2TI member. One account can belong to only one member.
Account already exists: An account with this email already exists.
Account already exists help: Sign in with that account, then connect it to AB2TI membership. Matching email is not proof of ownership.
Already have an account: Already have an account? Log in
Publications intro: AB2TI news, activities, press releases, and media coverage.
No publications yet: No publications have been published yet.
Related publications help: Other published publications of the same type.
Primary image help: The primary image is used on cards, the reading page, and sharing when no dedicated sharing image is set.
Publishing help: Save as a draft at any time. Publish and unpublish are separate, server-controlled actions.
SEO help: These fields are optional. If empty, the system uses the publication title, summary, or body.
Latest publications help: The three most recently published items.
Publish publication confirmation: This publication will appear on the public site. Visitors cannot open drafts.
Unpublish publication confirmation: The publication will return to draft and leave the public site. The last publication date is kept.
Delete publication confirmation: This draft will be deleted. A published publication must be unpublished first.
YouTube video help: Optional. Paste the YouTube video URL to display on the publication page.
